title: Paper Craft — An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Fold open, assemble, connect
scenes.purpose: A folded cream idea card opens on its crease. Kraft strips unroll to connect it to cardboard boxes, which fold up from flat nets into a connected system on a green cutting mat.
visuals: Three.js scene on a stationary green self-healing cutting mat with grid (scene-dependent background replacing the earlier cream poster field)
Cream card stock idea card with printed kraft lightbulb and 'FOLD · IDEA' label, procedurally folded along its center crease
Three kraft corrugated boxes made from constant-thickness panels with fluted edges, hinged walls, lid flaps and seam tape
Kraft connector strips that unroll from paper coils, pinned with brass brads
Soft warm key light with PCF soft shadows and a cool hemisphere fill
assets: Procedural seeded CanvasTextures: mat grid, paper fibers, kraft fibers, corrugated flutes

beats.development: The title fades in. The folded idea card opens 177° to 0° along its crease (arc-length-preserving fold, so the card does not stretch) and its free corner curls up and back down.
The first box's walls hinge up from its flat net, lid flaps close and seam tape runs across. The first kraft strip unrolls from the card to the box.
Two more strips unroll from the first box and the two connected boxes fold up, close and get taped. The subtitle appears.
Settled hold on the assembled, connected system so the full copy can be read.

findings: Primary focus moves left to right: card, then first box, then the two connected boxes, following the strips.
Hinge actions overlap and are staggered so each part reads as a separate assembly step within 3 s.
All motion is settled by 2.3 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.3–3.0 s: final reading hold for the title and subtitle over the completed system.

notes: Blender was not used, per user instruction. Three.js WebGL stands in for the Blender/Cycles paperboard route.

No preview_recipes were listed in STYLE.json, and BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json contains no matched sources or contact sheets. The background change is a scene-dependent choice, not something drawn from source frames.
